objective: a next order from customers who have gone quiet past their normal repeat window

trigger.definition: metric trigger Placed Order, then wait the repeat window; the flow filter removes anyone who orders in the meantime
trigger.source_object: Shopify orders via the Klaviyo Placed Order metric; repeat window from the RFM job (58 days at the last scoring)
trigger.re_entry: every new Placed Order restarts the clock; Klaviyo flows let a profile re-enter on each trigger event, so the flow filter is what prevents a double journey

entry_filters.condition: trigger filter: Placed Order value is greater than 0 (excludes $0 replacement and warranty orders)

ongoing_filters.condition: Placed Order zero times since starting this flow

suppressions: open support ticket tagged refund or complaint
received any campaign with a discount in the last 14 days

holdout.assignment: warehouse: lmm_holdout_winback = (abs(hash(customer_id)) % 5 = 0), synced as a profile property; holdout profiles still enter, wait the window and pass the repeat split, then exit at holdout_split, so both arms are the same population
holdout.sizing: about 2,500 entrants a month, 4% 60-day repurchase among lapsed customers, 1.5-point lift: 2,039 holdout entrants at 20%, 4.1 months of entries plus the 60-day outcome window, so the read lands about 6.0 months after launch (a 10% holdout: about 9.3 months) (tools/stats.py feasible --outcome-window-days 60)

frequency.cap: Smart Sending on (16 hours); at most 3 lifecycle emails a week across flows

branch.condition: Placed Order at least 2 times over all time
branch.no: exit (one order only: the second-order flow owns them; routed out before the holdout split so both arms hold the same population)

steps.message: Plain-text note from the head of customer care; no offer
What is new in their category since their last order; no discount

steps.condition: no order and no click since whats_new
steps.message: A/B at message level: free shipping vs no offer

steps.condition: no order and no click in the flow
steps.message: Do you still want these emails? One button to stay

steps.condition: no click on the re-permission email
steps.message: Update profile property lmm_sunset = true (suppression segment excludes from marketing)

measurement.primary_metric: 60-day repurchase rate from the repeat split (where the arms diverge), treatment vs holdout, on the Shopify orders object
measurement.read_after: 2,039 holdout entrants have each completed 60 days (about 6.0 months after launch)
guardrails: discount cost per incremental order (offer test)

data_dependencies.name: lmm_rfm_segment
data_dependencies.note: synced by the RFM job; scored weekly

data_dependencies.name: lmm_holdout_winback
data_dependencies.note: warehouse job to be scheduled before launch

data_dependencies.name: Favorite Category
data_dependencies.note: used with a fallback in the template; a research finding if under 60% filled

data_dependencies.name: lmm_orders_lifetime
data_dependencies.note: used in the high-value note with a fallback; add lifetime_orders to the RFM sync before launch
